notes: Company: mid-market B2B SaaS (LucidPath) — product = knowledge base + chat assistance for SMBs
Primary goal: replace brittle rule-based chat with LLM agent to handle complex refunds + triage
Latency target: first-token <1.5s (95th preferred), median <1.0s — streaming required for agent feel
Throughput: typical concurrency 80-120 reqs/min; peak bursts up to 400 concurrent short chats
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit for Dedicated if ROI and burst model clear
Model preference: open-weighted models ok; prefer Redwood verified configs and fallback to smaller model on congestion
Routing/fallback: must support tool-calling (ticket create, CRM lookup) and graceful fallback to stateless model during overload
Security: SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS integration non-negotiable; retention controls needed for 30-90d
"Quote from CTO": "We need the chat to feel instantaneous — customers churn when agent waits. <1.5s is our ceiling."
POC notes: hosted API streaming produced median FT 1.05s in our US-east test; 95th jumped to 2.1s during synthetic burst
SE observations: batching + prefix caching helped steady-state, but cold-starts and KV-cache misses caused spikes
Legal: asked for data residency attestation (US only) and export controls doc
Finance: wants 3 pricing options — pure hosted usage, hosted + burst cap, Dedicated 6/12 month commit
Internal champions: Head of Product (Ellen Park), CTO (Samir Patel). Exec sponsor = VP Ops (Dana Ortiz)
Decision timeline: target May 2026 (POC -> pricing -> procurement)
